title: Testing and Java Review
description: Proving code works: test-first unit tests with JUnit, fakes and stubs, mocking with Mockito and code coverage, then a review of the whole course and reading older Java code.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Foundation days F4-F18 (curriculum/snapshot/pep-curriculum.json /tracks/0/weeks/0/days/3 to /tracks/0/weeks/3/days/2). This module covers F17, F18 (/tracks/0/weeks/3/days/1, /tracks/0/weeks/3/days/2).
